Skip to concepts

EGYHEALTH 360 / NOVA / OWNER SELECTION PACKAGE

Three ideas. One name.

Original proposals for visual review. Same scale, palette and wordmark family; silhouette and construction carry the differences. No concept is selected.

تلات مقترحات لشعار EgyHealth 360. الاختيار أو التعديل أو الرفض لصاحب المنتج. دي مش هوية نهائية.

CONCEPT A
Shared stem

حروف مترابطة

A drawn e–h ligature: two initials share one structural stem, keeping the name at the center of recognition.

16px
24px
32px

The joined initials carry an explicit name cue, but e-health lettermarks remain crowded. Test whether the shared stem reads clearly rather than as an unrelated abstract glyph.

Inspect proofs
SVG
CONCEPT B
Changing course

مسار مستمر

An open rising ribbon with two unequal landings: care can continue through a change of context without a closed loop.

16px
24px
32px

A route or transport reading remains possible. This is a continuity metaphor, not speed, automatic referral, complete records or unrestricted access.

Inspect proofs
SVG
CONCEPT C
Unequal facets

أوجه متكاملة

Three unequal planes form a compact oblique silhouette. Shared visual language allows distinct responsibilities without literal role badges.

16px
24px
32px

Faceted systems are crowded in software, infrastructure and finance. Three planes are a construction choice, not a claim that the platform has three roles or a centralized data grant.

Inspect proofs
SVG
Choose A, B or C for further refinement, reject all, or name specific changes. A concept preference does not finalize the full identity.
Final Brand V2 and Design System V2 remain owner-gated. No legal clearance or measured user recognition is claimed.
